title: rosa graveolens subsp. nuda
intro: Rosa graveolens subsp. nuda, commonly known as the Naked Rose, is a subspecies of the Rosa graveolens plant, which is a fragrant, flowering shrub. The Naked Rose has been traditionally used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, providing various health benefits such as reducing stress and anxiety, promoting relaxation, and improving sleep quality. The plant's therapeutic actions include its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents like geraniol, linalool, and beta-pinene. These constituents are responsible for the plant's calming and soothing effects, making it a popular natural remedy for promoting emotional balance and overall well-being.
